annotation_method: Manual visible anatomical correspondences; front paired annotations use approximate symmetry around x=334. Pixels are reviewable estimates with uncertainty, not scan measurements. Hidden anatomy is regularized to a human-head prior.
annotation_review: Reviewed original front mouth and side profile at 5x/6x with pixel grids. Corrected lip-contact line, cupid bow, columella and mentolabial landmark labels; no reference image warp. Uncertain hidden cheek and brow contours remain low-confidence.
